docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
Odysseus' ten years of wandering after Troy and his return to Ithaca, told in blank verse.

From Standard Ebooks · CC0 1.0

Homer (about eighth century BC), Odyssey (Greek), translated by William Cullen Bryant (1794–1878), 1871. This book is not stored in this library: each chapter is read from the public repository of its Standard Ebooks edition when it is opened, shown in this library's format, and ends with its own attribution. Standard Ebooks edition, CC0 1.0 (public domain dedication); transcription originally from the Internet Archive. Modified: converted to this format.
